title: Coherent coefficient calculus with the fixed integral closed structure
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an arbitrary scheme $W$, with independent scheme universe $t$ and coefficient universe $u$. There exist a coefficient derived system calculus $S$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data] and a coherence witness [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus] such that its integral closed structure equals $(\mathrm{IntegralOnSlice.duality}\ \ell\ E\ W\ \mathrm{none}).\mathrm{closed}$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. This is equality of the chosen presentations, not an inference of equality from natural isomorphism. No invertibility of $\ell$ on $W$, open immersion, ordinary reduction model, completion model or open comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 07A4, 08JD (lemma-dual), 0A98 (lemma-internal-hom-composition), 0941; presentation-normalization refinement of the coherent coefficient calculus and step 1 of lem-pur-completed-open-tensor-context.

proof.text: Choose the existing coherent coefficient calculus. Construct its normalized tensors, representative models, reduction and quotient maps by explicit conjugation. The integral closed field is assigned IntegralOnSlice.duality.closed; no equality of isomorphic presentations is inferred.

Apply the proved representativeLaws. Retain all non-tensor fiber data. The baseChange_eq and fiberEvaluation calculations transport fiber evaluation, quotient transitions and beta evaluation. Naturality and transposition follow from the old equations and canonical adjoint comparison. Supply only the two internal-composition families from compositionLaws. This constructs the new fiber calculus explicitly. Retain finite tensor coherence as well: the uncurrying formulas determine any two tensor models for the same closed structure. Represent the transpose of one inverse comparison by an ordinary Hom chain map; the two uncurrying formulas produce chain maps equal on pure tensors, and cancellation identifies their comparison isomorphisms. Apply this to the transported model and the fixed RingedSiteDualityModel.models. The latter has constraint completion, which therefore supplies the missing finite coherence witness.

Retain the old globalLimit and resolution coherence. The proved enriched_eq makes the new gamma.hom equal the old one, so gamma projection, naturality and degree-zero Hom projection transfer verbatim. Enriched invertibility follows from coefficientClosedEnriched_isIso. Prove mapping composition directly by adjunction naturality and tensor-comparison naturality, as in the existing calculus assembly. Assemble the coherence record; the required integralClosed equality is reflexivity.
